scope: Computer Control Phase 9B3C diagnostic capture of AppKit completion after filePicker.accept
platform: macOS Cocoa/AppKit NSOpenPanel via registered Provider and native Accessibility

historicalEvidence.blockedCause: NSOpenPanel did not expose AXDefaultButton/AXCancelButton relationships on the tested surface
historicalEvidence.failedObservation: accept target delivered successfully and picker became absent, but the expected AppKit result label was not captured

safetyBoundary.productMutationUnderTest: filePicker.accept only after already validated exact item selection
safetyBoundary.diagnosticObservation: read-only Accessibility traversal of test-owned fixture result label
safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness may stop only its temporary test-owned fixture process

expectedCoverage: filePicker.accept remains IMPLEMENTED and is invoked through the current corrected backend
a real AppKit NSOpenPanel opens at PickerRoot
a separate read-only Accessibility helper captures the fixture Picker Result value after accept
the diagnostic records the exact AppKit completion text without assuming accepted/cancelled/other in advance
PASS means diagnostic evidence captured, not Phase 9B3C promotion
